name: unresolved-import
purpose: Five import shapes at once: one that resolves to a declaration file outside the module universe, one to a JSON module this version does not resolve, one to a Node built-in, one to an external package no manifest declares, and one to a file that is not there. Every one must keep its specifier, its line, and an honest resolution.
exercises: resolved edge to an out-of-universe declaration file, with a real cited line
platform resolution with no target node
dependency node minted by an import the manifest never declared
unresolved edge with a specifier, a line, and a reason
a JSON module this version does not resolve stays unresolved rather than gaining a target

inspiredBy.originalBehaviour: An import resolving to a `.d.ts` minted a module node citing line 1 of a file the run had never read. That was a `provenance-file-was-read` violation, which is error severity, which suppressed the entire graph for this repository and six others. The corpus study found it; the target is now read before it is cited.
